attchmntText: Titan Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Titan Company Limited has disclosed the schedule for analyst and institutional investor meetings in November 2026. A group meeting is planned for 24th November 2026 from 9:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m. at a physical venue. Participating firms include Alecta, Allianz Global Investors, Lazard Asset Management, Northrock Capital Management, Invesco Asset Management, and Tata Asset Management. The company states that no price sensitive information or forward looking statements will be disclosed during these meetings. The schedule is subject to change due to exigencies. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015.
